facts.fact: Huawei Cloud's customer case says Konza Technopolis has deployed a data center on Huawei Cloud Stack that serves more than 120 customers (75% governments, 25% private enterprises); the page is undated, so as_of is the 2025-07-24 capture date.

Huawei Cloud states that with Huawei Cloud Stack, Konza has deployed a data center that meets Tier-III standards (operator/vendor statement, no certification body named); undated page, 2025-07-24 is the capture date.

Huawei Cloud says KONZA is migrating government and public service systems to its unified cloud platform, which supports more than 70 key city services across government, healthcare and transportation; undated page, 2025-07-24 is the capture date.

systems.owner: KONZA (Konza Technopolis); ownership not stated beyond the name
